【原视频简介】
GLM 5.3 is here, and it’s a game-changer for developers! In this video, we test the GLM 5.3-Flash AI model to see if it can handle a complex, realistic 3D game inside the Unity game engine. While many creators use AI to build simple HTML games, we’re pushing GLM 5.3 to the limit by implementing advanced C# physics and game logic in a professional environment.

We put this new AI model to the test by building a real-time drifting calculator and a dynamic collectible spawning system. We also compare GLM 5.3 vs Kimi K3, looking at the massive price difference (GLM 5.3 is 3x cheaper!) and the 1 million context window performance. If you want to start making games using AI, this breakdown of GLM 5.3-Flash and its integration with VS Code and Unity is a must-watch.

[[Chapters]]
0:00 - Introduction to GLM 5.3 & Unity
0:30 - GLM 5.3 Specs vs Kimi K3 (Pricing & Context)
1:05 - The Limitations: Why Multimodal Matters
1:45 - Why Test AI on 3D Games vs HTML?
2:20 - Setting up GLM 5.3 in VS Code (Kilocode)
3:00 - Task 1: Building a Drift Calculation System
5:05 - Testing the AI-Generated Drift Feature
7:30 - Should I start a Game Dev channel?
8:15 - Task 2: Implementing a Collectibles Manager
9:40 - Testing Spawn Logic & Vehicle Interaction
10:50 - Final Verdict: Is GLM 5.3 the best coding LLM?
